meta.name: creating-springboot-projects
meta.description: Creates Java 25 and Spring Boot 4 project structures, scaffolds, and implementation starting points for new services, REST APIs, and modular backends. Use when the task is to initialize a Spring Boot project, choose an architecture, select Spring Boot 4 features, or apply the bundled templates and references in this skill. Do not use for migrating existing projects or for isolated JPA/repository work without broader project-creation context.

copy.tagline: 快速搭建 Spring Boot 4 项目骨架与 REST API 起点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次启动新后端项目都要从零配置 Spring Boot。
copy.tagline_en: Scaffold Spring Boot 4 projects and REST API starters quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you always set up Spring Boot from scratch for new backend projects.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你创建新的 Java 25 和 Spring Boot 4 项目，包括选择架构、添加依赖、应用模板文件，并输出项目结构和实施步骤。
howto.when: 当你要求初始化 Spring Boot 项目、选择架构或应用技能中的模板时触发。不用于迁移现有项目或孤立的 JPA 工作。

say.text: 帮我创建一个简单的 CRUD Spring Boot 4 项目。
say.note: Claude 会评估复杂度并推荐分层架构。

say.text: 我想用模块化单体架构建一个 Spring Boot 4 项目。
say.note: Claude 会读取架构指南并应用 Modulith 模板。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you to create new Java 25 and Spring Boot 4 projects, including choosing an architecture, adding dependencies, applying template files, and outputting project structure and implementation steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to initialize a Spring Boot project, choose an architecture, or apply the skill's templates. Not for migrating existing projects or isolated JPA work.

say_en.text: Create a simple CRUD Spring Boot 4 project for me.
say_en.note: Claude will assess complexity and recommend layered architecture.

say_en.text: I want to build a Spring Boot 4 project with modular monolith architecture.
say_en.note: Claude will read the architecture guide and apply Modulith templates.
